issues.quote: A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven. That is the only hour I can give you with any confidence.
issues.fact: O4 gives only that the hall clock struck eleven a moment after he came back. Nothing in the fact sheet says her other readings (the nine, the ten, the watches) are unreliable.
issues.misreading: The added disclaimer says only the eleven o'clock reading is trustworthy. A solver could reasonably discount the temple's ten o'clock strike, or the nine o'clock watch check, and so reach a different timeline for when the doctor left and returned.

issues.quote: I played Chopin until he came back, and I stopped when he came in.
issues.fact: O3 says only that she sat at the piano at once and played until he came back, then stopped when he came in. It does not name the piece.
issues.misreading: The named composer adds a detail the sheet does not give. It does not change any clock reading, so the effect on the timeline is slight.
